name: Apex SEO Intelligence
author: Apex Digital ⭐

sections.description:
Apex SEO Intelligence is an advanced Google Search Console analytics dashboard for WordPress.

It provides real-time SEO insights, revenue estimation, keyword tracking, and actionable recommendations to help website owners improve rankings, increase traffic, and grow revenue.

Designed for performance, clarity, and usability, the dashboard transforms raw Search Console data into meaningful insights and optimization opportunities.

Features

  • Google Search Console integration
  • Real-time SEO performance data
  • SEO Score (visual performance indicator)
  • Clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position tracking
  • 7 / 30 / 90 day performance views
  • Performance trend charts
  • Top Pages analysis with actionable insights
  • Top Keywords tracking with scoring and opportunities
  • Quick Wins (low-hanging SEO opportunities)
  • CTR optimization suggestions
  • Rule-based insights and recommendations
  • Revenue Intelligence (estimated SEO value and opportunity)
  • Lost revenue detection
  • Priority scoring system
  • Action Center with recommended tasks
  • Device breakdown (mobile, desktop, tablet)
  • Country traffic insights
  • Export reports (CSV and PDF)
  • Modern, high-performance UI

External Services

This plugin connects to Google Search Console APIs to retrieve search performance and indexing data for sites authorized by the user.

Data transmitted:

  • Authorized Google OAuth tokens
  • Search Console property URLs
  • Search Console query requests

Google Privacy Policy:
https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Terms:
https://policies.google.com/terms

This plugin also connects to the Apex Digital OAuth Broker service to securely manage Google OAuth authentication.

Data transmitted:

  • OAuth authorization codes
  • OAuth refresh tokens
  • Authentication requests

Privacy Policy:
https://apexdigital.design/privacy-policy/

Terms of Service:
https://apexdigital.design/terms-of-service/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Open “Apex SEO Intelligence” from the WordPress admin menu
  4. Connect your Google Search Console account
  5. Select your property and start analyzing your data
sections.faq:
Do I need a Google Search Console account?

Yes. This plugin requires a connected Google Search Console account.

Does this plugin modify my site SEO automatically?

No. The plugin provides insights and recommendations. You decide what changes to apply.

Can I export my data?

Yes. CSV and PDF export options are included.
